description: This file is a PHP test class for the FormatWithJobCategory class within the OrangeHRM project. It sets up a test environment, populates test data from a YAML fixture, and tests the formatted value retrieval method for job categories.

classes.name: FormatWithJobCategoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the functionality of the FormatWithJobCategory class, specifically testing the formatted value retrieval for assigned job categories.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by setting the path to the fixture YAML file, populating it with test data, and instantiating the FormatWithJobCategory object.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that the getFormattedValue method returns the expected string for a valid job category ID and null for an invalid ID.
